== a player's character is placed
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a player's character moves
master: token_moved map pens (3500, 3000)
ana: token_moved map pens (3500, 3000)
caio: token_moved map pens (3500, 3000)
== a goblin is placed (hidden)
master: map_changed map
ana: -
caio: -
== a hidden goblin moves
master: token_moved map goblin (5500, 5000)
ana: -
caio: -
== a hidden goblin is shown
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a visible goblin moves
master: token_moved map goblin (6000, 5000)
ana: token_moved map goblin (6000, 5000)
caio: token_moved map goblin (6000, 5000)
== a visible goblin is hidden
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a hidden goblin is removed
master: map_changed map
ana: -
caio: -
== a goblin is placed and shown
master: map_changed map; map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a visible goblin picks up a torch
master: map_changed map
ana: -
caio: -
== a visible goblin is removed
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a second player's character is placed
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a player's character is removed
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== the map is hidden from the players
master: map_changed map
ana: map_changed map
caio: map_changed map
== a token moves on a map the players do not see
master: token_moved map toren (8500, 8000)
ana: -
caio: -
== a goblin is placed on a map the players do not see
